main.description: Re-ingest stale rows from vertex_hf_dataset (HuggingFace dataset catalog mirror). Iterates dataset rows older than `staleSeconds` and re-fetches up to `perDatasetLimit` rows per dataset. Used by the R/P30D adsk_ingest_dataset autopilot.

staleSeconds.description: Re-ingest datasets whose last_ingested_at is older than this many seconds. Default: 30 days.

perDatasetLimit.description: Maximum rows fetched per dataset on each refresh. Default: 10000.

schema.description: Per-dataset ingest summary. Failures are captured under `summary[*].error` rather than aborting the run.
